context_for_next_testing_agent: Worker desync bug FIXED: 1) seed_completed flag in settings collection prevents re-seeding Ana on restart. 2) Three workers active: Suzana (hair: 69d4d6f82990ad8a6366bf7d), Milena (nails: 69d4d6f82990ad8a6366bf7e), Slobodan (massage: 69d4d6f82990ad8a6366bf7f). 3) Ana permanently deleted from DB. 4) Referential integrity check prevents deleting workers with future bookings. 5) Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_worker_desync_fix.py covers all worker-related endpoints.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: The startup_event was re-seeding Ana on every server restart because there was no flag to track if initial seeding was completed. Fix: Added seed_completed document in settings collection. Once seeded, startup_event checks for this flag and skips all service/worker seeding. Ana was manually deleted from DB after the fix was applied.
